content:
anya-peopleops: Hi @devon — quick thread to align Day 1 logistics and a compact manager checklist for the new PM starting Monday. Keeping it intentionally short so you can paste into a calendar invite.

devon-manager: Thanks! I'll need product analytics dashboard access, Notion team space, and the staging project in GCP. Laptop request: M1 Pro is fine, but needs HDMI adapter.

rachel-it: Noted. For staging access we need the GCP project id and the user's corp email. For dashboards: add them to the 'metrics-readers' group. If you want the dashboard edit rights, say so. Procurement ETA for laptops is 3-6 biz days; we can arrange a loaner for Week 1.

zoe-hr: Manager checklist (short):
- pre-Day1: confirm access list to IT + submit laptop type in the hardware form
- Day1 AM: HR paperwork + benefits overview (30m)
- Day1 mid: team intro + role expectations (30m)
- End of Day1: 20m sync with manager for first-week priorities

Also: please send an intro to the company Slack #general (1-2 lines) and post an Asana onboarding task with the first deliverable.

devon-manager: Can you share a 30/60/90 I can give them? Prefer something focused on outcomes rather than tasks.

anya-peopleops: Sure, short outcome-driven 30/60/90 template: 
- 30 days (observe & learn): meet core stakeholders, complete compliance trainings, ship a 1-page problem summary and expected impact for the highest-priority area
- 60 days (deliver & iterate): own one customer-facing experiment or small cross-team project end-to-end, present findings to product/eng
- 90 days (scale & influence): propose a measurable change (OKR or process) and run a pilot; demonstrate cross-functional influence and ownership

Additions: include measurable success criteria for each milestone (e.g., "30d: 5 stakeholder interviews completed", "60d: experiment launched and metrics dashboard tracking").

harry-engineer: From an onboarding engineering angle: please schedule these in Week 1:
- infra intro with SRE (30m) to get VPN/KMS + CI expectations
- repo walkthrough + first small PR (pair with buddy)
- access to staging+test tokens

For the access form, here's a minimal example you can paste:
```
Access request:
- Name: Jamie Liu
- Email: jamie.liu@redwood.ai
- Role: Product Manager
- GCP project: rwd-staging-pm
- Groups: metrics-readers, pm-core, staging-deployers
- Hardware: Laptop M1 Pro + HDMI adapter (loaner if delayed)
```

devon-manager: Great. I'll submit that tonight. Who should I loop in if staging requires extra approval?

rachel-it: Tag me and @kevin-sre in the access form. If there are sensitive KMS keys involved we do a short approval (usually same day if justification is included).

onboarding-bot: :white_check_mark: Onboarding plan created for jamie.liu@redwood.ai. Calendar invites sent for Day 1 items.

zoe-hr: Manager action items recap (one-line each):
- submit access form + hardware order (devon)
- schedule 1:1s: Day2 30m check-in, weekly recurring 1:1 (devon)
- assign buddy and first PR task (devon + harry)
- share 30/60/90 template + define 30-day success criteria (devon)

anya-peopleops: Sample Day 1 calendar blocks you can copy:
- 09:00 10:00 HR intro + paperwork (zoe-hr)
- 10:00 10:30 Security/VPN (rachel-it)
- 10:45 11:30 Team intros + role expectations (devon-manager)
- 12:00 13:00 Lunch + casual meet (team)
- 13:00 14:00 Tools walk (Notion, Asana, Dashboards) (devon + harry-engineer)
- 15:00 15:30 Buddy pairing + first task assignment
- 16:00 16:20 Quick manager sync (devon-manager)

devon-manager: Thanks all — I'll send the intro to #general after invites are out. Will confirm hardware request and access form tonight.

onboarding-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow up on hardware order in 4 business days. :calendar:
